svg.title: First come first served, SCAN and LOOK for the same three requests
svg.desc: A car at floor 4 heading up has requests for floors 8, 2 and 6, pressed in that order. First come first served goes 4, 8, 2, 6: 14 floors. SCAN goes up to the top floor 9 serving 6 and 8, then down to 2: 12 floors. LOOK turns at the last request, 8, instead of the top: 4 to 8 then 2, 10 floors.
svg.text: car at 4 going up; requests 8, 2, 6 (pressed in that order)
across: floors travelled; dots: requests served; SCAN wastes the trip from 8 to the top
